children: took the wraps off its new iPhone models on Wednesday, including the iPhone 18 Pro.

The iPhone 18 Pro comes in black, silver, a new color called "glacier," and burgundy. It sports the new A20 Pro chip and a new Camera system, which allows for even further editing and personalization of photos and videos. Siri is also built right into the camera, Apple added.

The A20 Pro chip uses the latest 2-nanometer technology and has a 6-core CPU and a 7-core GPU, providing a 40% increase in performance over the iPhone 17 Pro and twice as much power as the 16 Pro and older. It also comes with a new version of Apple's neural accelerator that helps power advanced artificial intelligence, with the neural engine acting as a dedicated AI accelerator. The A20 Pro also has a second neural engine.

Improvements were also made to the battery, with the all-day battery providing 36 hours of video playback on the 18 Pro and 45 hours on the Pro Max. The Pro has 24 hours per charge and 30 hours per charge, and wireless charging is faster than over the previous generation.

The iPhone 18 Pro has a 48 MP Fusion main camera to help support variable aperture, with the aperture adjusting depending upon the environment. It also comes with a new Pro Controls system used to customize camera settings and experience, such as applying a histogram or changing white controls.
The iPhone 18 Pro has an upgraded and redesigned Dynamic Island, keeping track of three items at once.
The iPhone 18 Pro starts at $1,199 and has a 2 TB option, while the iPhone 18 Pro starts at $1,299. Pre-orders start on Sept. 12 and are available on Sept. 18.

title: Apple takes wraps off iPhone 18 Pro, Pro Max
